2608.16621.title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
2608.16621.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.
2608.16621.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強和代理式問答系統越來越多地在查詢時重新推導語料庫的含義。<lb/>簡而言之，這意味著在每個問題上不再重新推導語料庫的含義，而是在文檔到達時進行一次推導，之後僅進行查詢——這是一個意義的編譯器，而不是解釋器。<lb/>另一種選擇是在攝取時一次性編譯這個含義，將其轉換為一個緊湊的、可查詢的語義基底，並在語料庫演變時保持它。<lb/>主要的反對意見是維護成本：在每次變更時重建截斷的奇異值分解（SVD）似乎是不可承擔的，並且嵌入模型的變更似乎強迫進行全面重新嵌入。<lb/>我們主張並實證證明維護成本與變更的量相關，而不是語料庫的大小。<lb/>在一個受控的合成試點（維度256，秩32，語料庫在50次更新事件中從3,000增長到9,000文檔）中，增量低秩更新的每次更新成本比全面重新SVD便宜33.7倍，累計便宜23.8倍，而增量子空間的跟蹤精確到浮點數精度（最大主角漂移低於1e-11度；recall@10 = 1.0）。<lb/>一個正交的Procrustes虛擬軸更新通過僅重新嵌入約10%的語料庫，恢復了0.95的平均餘弦，以真正的重新嵌入向量。<lb/>這些結果支持維護，而不是反覆重建語義基底。
